geometry.description: sc-18812. Same key vocabulary as `memoryCharacterization.measuredGeometries`, produced by the same `measuredGeometryKey`: `WxH` is one output frame, `WxHxfF` is F of them. Both forms are admitted here because an evidence record supporting a temporal curve must be able to STATE its frame count - a record forced into `WxH` would be characterized as a one-frame design point nobody measured.

requiredHostBytes.description: Exact MLX host requirement: max(predicted peak, observed non-reclaimable wired peak) plus the captured foreign unified-memory reserve.

geometry.description: sc-18812. `WxH` (one output frame) or `WxHxfF`, from the same `measuredGeometryKey` as every other geometry key in this document.

rung4StructuralApplicability.description: How much of the family's transformer trunk `gen_core::block_window` can bound. `partial` is the value the five-state conformance vocabulary cannot express.

rung4RequestPeak.description: Whether bounding the trunk was MEASURED to move the request peak. Separate from applicability on purpose: a strategy that bounds a phase without moving the request peak is not a saving.

entries.description: Present when the stack exists on only some of the family's catalog entries, so a per-entry difference stays machine-readable instead of being rounded into the family verdict. Every id is checked to belong to the owning family at generation time.

rung4SurveyVerdict.description: SC-15969 per-family rung-4 applicability, as it rides ONE cell. `structuralApplicability` and `requestPeak` are two SEPARATE findings by design: a family can be structurally capable and still correctly default to not using the rung, because a strategy that bounds a phase without moving the request peak is not a saving. `partial` is the value the five-state conformance vocabulary cannot express — a trunk that is not one uniform stack. `overlayIncompatible` is deliberately NOT folded into `structuralApplicability`: it is a property of the provider's adapter mechanism, so a family whose stack is perfectly windowable would otherwise publish `none` on its overlay cells. sc-18099 moved the family-level `summary`/`blockStacks`/`findings` to `rung4SurveyRows`, where they are carried once per (family, backend) and survive the elision of every one of that family's cells.

surveyed.description: sc-18815. False when the cell's family has no rung-4 verdict yet, which the modality-aware universe makes reachable: a modality is admitted one story at a time, so a family can be in the matrix before its survey lands. It is present on EVERY rung-4 cell rather than only the false ones, because a consumer inferring it from an absent key is the hole this field exists to close. When false, the three verdict fields are null/`unsurveyed` and `pendingSurveyStory` names who owes the verdict — the cell reports `Missing` for a reason it states, not for the reason a surveyed family with no implementation would.

overlayIncompatible.description: True when THIS cell is exempt because the provider's adapter mechanism cannot carry an overlay onto a rebuilt block. Scoped to cells whose entry and mode actually have the streaming path: on a route with no such path the rung is Missing for the ordinary reason, so a sibling cell of the same provider can read `false` while the provider-level fact still holds.

familyGroup.description: sc-18815. A family group key. Image families (epic SC-15448) are keyed by the family's MLX story id; the video families epic 18803 admits are keyed by the family's own NAME, because sc-18828 owns three unrelated families at once and no assignment of story ids to those families is both distinct and true. `VIDEO_FAMILY_STORIES` in the generator answers the ownership question the key used to answer implicitly.

backendScopedStories.description: Owning Shortcut story per advertised backend (SC-15812). An mlx-only entry carries only `mlx`; a Candle cell can never be covered by the MLX story. sc-18815: `null` is permitted, and means there is no story of that role for this entry at all — the video lane's `owningModelStories`, because epic 18803 filed no per-(entry, backend) video stories. Empty for an entry the routing catalog routes nowhere.

schemaVersion.description: 2 (SC-15812): backend-scoped story ownership. 3 (sc-16268): removed per-cell evidenceRevision. 4 (SC-15969): added rung-4 survey rows. 5 (SC-16060): split implementation and memory-characterization claims. 6 (SC-15823): adds Runtime verified so base-only runtime activation cannot masquerade as Full Verified, and publishes complete/runtime-complete calibration counts. 7 (sc-18099): `cells` is the planned-or-evidenced SUBSET of the catalog cross-product rather than the cross-product itself; `coverage`, `models[].axes` and `manifestScopes` added and required; `summary` gained publishedCells/elidedCells/elidedByState/publicationPredicate; `modelSlices` entries may be empty; `rung4SurveyRows` absorbed the family-level summary/blockStacks/findings that `cells[].rung4Survey` no longer carries; `cells[].evidence` replaced declaredCalibration/loadability with a `manifestScope` key into `manifestScopes`; `calibrationRuns[].record` is a projection of the evidence-bundle row. 8 (sc-18815): the model universe is MODALITY-AWARE rather than `type === "image"`. `summary.imageModels` was REMOVED and replaced by `catalogEntries` + `catalogEntriesByModality` — not additive, because a reader indexing `imageModels` now gets `undefined` rather than a wrong number, which is the point; `models[]` gained required `modality` and `resolvedRoutes` and its count moved 53 -> 63; `models[].backends` and `owningModelStories` may be EMPTY (an entry the routing catalog routes nowhere); `cells[].owningModelStory` may be `null` (video cells have no per-entry owner); `cells[].rung4Survey` gained a required `surveyed` discriminator and its three verdict fields became nullable; `rung4SurveyRows[].familyStory` may be a family NAME rather than a story id; `summary` gained `unroutedEntries`, `videoMlxStagedStaticCoverage`(+`Denominator`) and `rung4Survey.pendingFamilyBackends`.

catalogEntries.description: sc-18815. The number of entries in the model universe, across every admitted modality. Named `imageModels` until video was admitted, at which point the name stopped being true of the number it held — a field called `imageModels` reading 63 is worse than the image-only universe it replaced.

catalogEntriesByModality.description: sc-18815. `catalogEntries` split by modality, so a video entry appearing can never cover for an image entry disappearing.

unroutedEntries.description: sc-18815. Entries in the universe that the routing catalog routes on NO backend, so they resolve to zero coordinates. Published because "emits nothing" and "is not in the catalog" are otherwise indistinguishable in this artifact, which is the silent absence this story exists to end.

cells.description: sc-18099: the number of coordinates the CATALOG resolved to, which is NOT `cells.length` any more. `publishedCells` + `elidedCells` partition it.

elidedCells.description: Coordinates resolved but not written, because nothing planned, measured, bound or cited them. Named rather than silently capped: their states are counted in `elidedByState` and their per-lane population in `coverage`.

publicationPredicate.description: The exact rule that decided publication, so a reader can tell what an absent coordinate means. Generated from scripts/generate-memory-matrix.mjs#PUBLICATION_PREDICATE.

pendingFamilyBackends.description: sc-18815. Families in the model universe whose rung-4 verdict has not been written yet, with the story that owes it. Every one of their rung-4 cells carries `rung4Survey.surveyed: false`, so an unsurveyed family is never readable as a surveyed one that was found to have no implementation. Empty once every admitted family is surveyed.

rung4SurveyRows.description: One row per surveyed (family story, backend). Derived from the generated cells, not re-read from the survey file, so a verdict that never reached a cell cannot appear here as though it had.

familyGroup.description: sc-18815. The family group key this entry belongs to, so a consumer can join it to `rung4SurveyRows` and `summary.rung4Survey.pendingFamilyBackends`. Derivable from `owningFamilyStories.mlx` for image entries only — an image family's key IS its MLX story id — and that coincidence does not hold for video, where the key is a family name and the owner is a survey story.

modality.description: sc-18815. The catalog modality this entry belongs to. The matrix universe was `type === "image"` until this story; publishing the modality is what lets a consumer tell an image cell from a video one, and what the per-modality censuses in `summary` are derived from.

resolvedRoutes.description: sc-18815. The provider each advertised backend resolves to. Video providers are genuinely per-backend — LTX is `ltx_2_3` on MLX and `ltx_2_3_distilled` on candle — so the scalar `resolvedRoute` cannot describe them. Empty for an entry the routing catalog routes nowhere (`summary.unroutedEntries`).

axes.description: sc-18099. The coordinate axes this entry resolves on each advertised backend. These ARE the cross-product `cells` used to enumerate, published so that eliding an unmeasured coordinate can never make a lane invisible — the sc-16069 failure, where a shipping control lane with no measurement block produced zero cells and absent evidence read as absent feature. Reconciled against the resolved cross-product by validateMatrix before either artifact is written.

coverage.description: sc-18099. One row per (catalog entry, backend, rung), derived from EVERY resolved coordinate — published or elided. This is the census the cross-product used to be: a consumer that counted `cells` by state reads `states` here and gets the same numbers, including for lanes the slim published nothing from. Its totals are reconciled against the resolved coordinate count and the published cell count by assertPublishedDocumentIsClosed before either artifact is written.

implemented.description: Coordinates whose state passes scripts/generate-memory-matrix.mjs#isImplemented, counted over the whole lane rather than over the published subset.

implementedBy.description: Per-axis MARGINALS of `implemented`, present on exactly the rows where 0 < implemented < coordinates — the rows a bare count cannot answer. A row spans tier x mode x overlay, so without this a partially implemented lane hides WHICH coordinates: `krea_2_turbo:mlx` rung 4 reads implemented 12/18 while its control overlay is really 0/6, which is the sc-16069 confusion (unmeasured lane vs absent lane) for the exact family sc-16069 was about. Every value the lane spans appears, including the zeroes. Marginals, not a joint distribution: each axis independently sums to `implemented`, checked before the artifact is written.

manifestScopes.description: sc-18099. The two manifest-derived evidence dimensions, published once per (entry, backend, tier) scope instead of once per coordinate. `declaredCalibration` and `loadability` are functions of that scope alone — which is also why neither is an arm of the publication predicate — so per-coordinate copies restated 35 distinct values 182 times. Cells point here through `evidence.manifestScope`; both directions of that reference, and the scope-invariance the hoist depends on, are checked before the artifact is written.

cells.description: sc-18099: the planned-or-evidenced SUBSET of the catalog cross-product, not the cross-product. `summary.publicationPredicate` states the rule that decided membership and `summary.elidedCells` counts what it dropped. No useful minItems exists any more — the population is a function of what has been planned and measured, so any floor here would either be vacuous or would fail the day a lane is descoped. Completeness of the underlying cross-product is still enforced before publication by assertCellInventoryMatchesCatalog, and closure of what was written by assertPublishedDocumentIsClosed, both in scripts/generate-memory-matrix.mjs.

owningModelStory.description: sc-18815. Null on a VIDEO cell: epic 18803 filed no per-(entry, backend) video stories — measurement is a runbook, per epic 18093 — so any integer here would name a story that cannot close the cell, which is the false inventory SC-15812's guard exists to prevent. Always an integer on an image cell.

manifestScope.description: sc-18099: key into the document's `manifestScopes` map, holding this coordinate's `declaredCalibration` and `loadability`. Both are functions of (entry, backend, tier) alone, so publishing them per coordinate restated 35 distinct values across 182 cells. `evidenceDimensions` still names all six dimensions — what changed is where two of them are written. Always `<modelId>:<backend>:<tier>`, checked against the cell's own coordinate before the artifact is written.

memoryCharacterization.description: SC-16060. The geometry-sensitive claim, kept separate from `state` so that one measured geometry cannot read as certifying a whole envelope. `coveredPixelBound` is null unless `status` is `fitted`. sc-18812: a measured geometry may carry a temporal axis as `WxHxfF`; the `WxH` form means one output frame and is what every image cell publishes.

coveredFrameBound.description: sc-18812. Largest measured output frame count, null unless `status` is `fitted`. Present ONLY on cells carrying a temporal measured geometry, mirroring how `geometryEnvelope` gains `durations`/`fps` only for video - so image cells keep the shape they published before the temporal axis existed. Read it against the cell's own `geometryEnvelope`: a gap between the two is the part of the temporal envelope the curve does not reach, and the worst case in that gap is NOT at the envelope's maximum. Peak memory is non-monotonic in frames, because the VAE switches to tiled decode on a constant-voxel surface (`i32::MAX / full_res_channels`, 297 output frames at 0.90 MP for LTX) where single-pass decode has already climbed to its maximum.

allOf.description: SC-15969: the survey verdict rides exactly the rung-4 cells. Required there so a cell cannot escape the survey; forbidden elsewhere so the field cannot drift onto another rung and be read as one.

record.description: sc-18099: a PROJECTION of the evidence-bundle row, not the row. The full record ships and is schema-validated in docs/generated/memory-calibration-evidence.json; embedding all 65 verbatim cost 436 KB of duplication. `id` is the join key and `source` spells the join out. Kept here is exactly what the matrix itself asserts about a record: which coordinate it targets, what composition it exercised, how it dates, and which fingerprint it carries.

modelSlices.description: Published cell ids per catalog entry. sc-18099 dropped the former 5-item floor: an entry with nothing planned, measured, bound or cited publishes NO cells, and an empty slice is the honest answer. Its lane totals remain in `coverage`.
